source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**Force** means the two partners’ armies taken together. A **Unified Force** requires identical sets of faction keywords across those armies. **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** **forces** can qualify as a **Unified Force** even if their units have different Chapter keywords. Classify every other **force** as a **Force of Convenience**.

**Designer’s Note**. Leave allied units out when classifying a **force**. For example, omit an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit taken as an ally by an **IMPERIUM** army. Apply the **Unified Force** test to the rest, then use **Force of Convenience** if it fails.
